title: ReqIF mapping file
description: Mapping of the types and attributes of one ReqIF source to the own metamodel, saved as YAML in the mapping folder of the workspace (`mappings`, default `reqif` in the main repository) and reused for every later import from and export to that source (N-045, D-022, SR-054). The own metamodel is never changed by it (SR-054 AK3). Also holds saved export profiles (SR-059 AK3).

source.description: The ReqIF source this mapping is for.

name.description: Name of the source as written to the property with meaning `source` (SR-057, D-059).

tool-id.description: REQ-IF-TOOL-ID seen in deliveries, for recognising the source.

target.description: Folder where imported elements are written.

types.description: Each SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE of the source, mapped to a type or omitted.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE.

omit.description: Objects of this type are not imported; each is listed as a loss.

attributes.description: Each ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION of the source, mapped to the title, the text or a property, or omitted.

source-type.description: Restricts the entry to one SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION.

property.description: Where the value goes: `title`, `text` or the key of a property.

omit-values.description: Enumeration values left out on import, each listed as a loss (SR-055 AK2).

omit.description: The attribute is not imported, which is listed as a loss.

relations.description: Each SPEC-RELATION-TYPE of the source, mapped to a relation kind or omitted.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the SPEC-RELATION-TYPE.

omit.description: Relations of this type are not imported.

statement.description: Where the statement goes when exporting back to the source (SR-058).

property.description: Own property that holds the statement.

datatype.description: How the statement is written: as STRING, or as XHTML converted from its Markdown (SR-058 AK1).

omit-properties.description: Properties left out of every export to this source; written by `reqif.export` with `mapping` and `omitProperties` (SR-059 AK1, AK3).

export-profiles.description: Saved exports to this source, each a selection under a name.

omit-properties.description: Properties left out of every export with this profile (SR-059 AK1).
